verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents both custom machine templates (create/reuse a template capturing your own machine configuration) and Deployments, a containers-as-a-service feature explicitly for running your own container images to serve models, directly covering the story's two use cases. Machine creation flow also lets you pick a custom template at provisioning time. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that custom Docker image deployment or custom template creation works smoothly in practice (community evidence is mixed/negative on other Paperspace features but doesn't specifically test this capability).
